description: Event dimension table from Silver events with category and hierarchy
steps: Create ClickHouse DDL for dim_event (ReplacingMergeTree(updated_at), ORDER BY (platform, platform_event_id))
Define schema: platform, platform_event_id, title, description, slug, status, category, updated_at
Read Silver polymarket.events via PyIceberg and transform to dim_event rows
Write to S3 Gold Parquet + load into ClickHouse
Scaffold Kalshi dim_event (DDL supports any platform, loader stubbed, no data)
Write unit tests for Silver events → dim_event transform (field mapping, nulls, dedup by platform_event_id)

description: Category dimension derived from Silver events category field
steps: Create ClickHouse DDL for dim_category (ReplacingMergeTree(version), ORDER BY (platform, category))
Extract distinct categories from Silver events, compute event_count per category
Write to S3 Gold Parquet + load into ClickHouse
Write unit tests for category extraction and aggregation

description: CLI registration and integration testing for event dimension loading
steps: Register dim_event and dim_category in LOADABLE_DIMS in src/prediction_data/cli/gold.py
Wire CLI dispatch to call load_dim_event() and load_dim_category()
Write integration test: Silver events → dim_event + dim_category round-trip (S3 + CH)
Verify `prediction-data gold load-dims --table dim_event` and `--table dim_category` work
